hints.title: Parity Transformation Rules
hints.text: Transforming each number replaces evens with 0 and odds with 1.

hints.title: Binary Sorting Property
hints.text: Sorting an array consisting solely of 0s and 1s puts all 0s first, followed by all 1s.

hints.title: Direct Construction by Counting
hints.text: Count the number of even integers in the input. Produce that many 0s followed by remaining 1s.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass counts even integers and constructs zeros followed by ones.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: General sorting takes O(n log n), whereas counting parities runs in linear time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Linear counting avoids sorting comparisons entirely.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize that sorting binary values reduces to counting zeros and ones.
